passages.text: EVERSOURCE ENERGY AND SUBSIDIARIES The following discussion and analysis should be read in conjunction with our consolidated financial statements and related combined notes included in this combined Annual Report on Form 10-K. References in this combined Annual Report on Form 10-K to "Eversource," the "Company," "we," "us," and "our" refer to Eversource Energy and its consolidated subsidiaries. All per-share amounts are reported on a diluted basis. The consolidated financial statements of Eversource, NSTAR Electric and PSNH and the financial statements of CL&P are herein collectively referred to as the "financial statements." Our discussion of fiscal year 2025 compared to fiscal year 2024 is included herein. Unless expressly stated otherwise, for discussion and analysis of fiscal year 2023 items and of fiscal year 2024 compared to fiscal year 2023, please refer to Item 7, Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations, in our combined 2024 Annual Report on Form 10-K , which is incorporated herein by reference. Refer to the Glossary of Terms included in this combined Annual Report on Form 10-K for abbreviations and acronyms used throughout this Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations . The only common equity securities that are publicly traded are common shares of Eversource. Our earnings discussion includes financial measures that are not recognized under GAAP (non-GAAP) referencing our earnings and EPS excluding losses associated with our previous offshore wind investments, a loss on the pending sale of the Aquarion water distribution business, and a loss on the disposition of land that was initially acquired to construct the Northern Pass Transmission project and was subsequently abandoned. EPS by business is also a non-GAAP financial measure and is calculated by dividing the Net Income Attributable to Common Shareholders of each business by the weighted average diluted Eversource common shares outstanding for the period. The earnings and EPS of each business do not represent a direct legal interest in the assets and liabilities of such business, but rather represent a direct interest in our assets and liabilities as a whole. We use these non-GAAP financial measures to evaluate and provide details of earnings results by business and to more fully compare and explain our results without including these items. This information is among the primary indicators we use as a basis for evaluating performance and planning and forecasting of future periods. We believe the impacts of the losses associated with our previous offshore wind investments, the loss on the pending sale of the Aquarion water distribution business, and the loss on the disposition of land associated with an abandoned project are not indicative of our ongoing costs and performance. We view these charges as not directly related to the ongoing operations of the business and therefore not an indicator of baseline operating performance. credit_strengths.text: Regulated electric utility scale supports revenue and operating income growth, with operating margin improving year over year and EBITDA coverage of interest rising above the prior year and modestly above the sector median, indicating steady regulated earnings quality.

Operating cash flow covers the dividend multiple times over and cash flow to debt improved sharply year over year and sits marginally above the sector median, evidencing the regulated utility's dependable cash generation relative to peers.

key_risks.text: Gross and net leverage remain elevated in the highly leveraged band, though both improved year over year and sit modestly below the sector median; the indicative profile is weaker than the peer positioning implies, so deleveraging must be sustained through rate-base growth.

Disclosed charges tied to prior offshore wind investments, the pending Aquarion water business sale and an abandoned transmission land disposition distort reported earnings, and management excludes them as non-indicative; execution and regulatory recovery on these items remain a concrete earnings risk.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage improved year over year but remains below the sector median, and EBITDA coverage is only marginally above peers; with heavy capital expenditure nearly matching operating cash flow, free cash flow is slightly negative and does not cover the dividend.

Debt is predominantly long-dated, with the bulk maturing beyond year five and only a modest slice due within the next twelve months; refinancing needs are manageable but recurring, and the low current ratio reflects utility working-capital structure rather than near-term liquidity stress.

overall_credit_view.text: Eversource presents a regulated electric utility credit with dependable operating cash flow and improving leverage and coverage trends, positioned slightly better than the sector median on leverage and cash flow to debt; the indicative highly leveraged profile reflects capital intensity rather than distress.

Our judgement is that credit quality hinges on regulatory outcomes and funding the capital programme, since free cash flow is negative and distributions absorb operating cash flow; interest coverage below peers and the disclosed non-recurring charges warrant monitoring, with modest headroom to the next leverage upgrade threshold.

credit_strengths.text: 受監管電力公用事業的規模支持收入及營業收入增長，營業利潤率按年改善，EBITDA對利息的覆蓋率較上年上升並略高於行業中位數，顯示穩定的受監管盈利質量。
經營現金流足以多次覆蓋股息，現金流對債務比率按年大幅改善並略高於行業中位數，印證該受監管公用事業相對同業的可靠現金生成能力。

key_risks.text: 總槓桿及淨槓桿仍處於高槓桿區間，儘管兩者均按年改善並略低於行業中位數；指示性狀況弱於同業定位所暗示的水平，因此去槓桿必須透過費率基礎增長持續推進。
與先前海上風電投資、待決的Aquarion水務業務出售及一項已放棄的輸電土地處置相關的已披露費用扭曲了報告盈利，管理層將其排除為非指示性；該等項目的執行及監管回收仍是具體的盈利風險。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率按年改善但仍低於行業中位數，EBITDA覆蓋率僅略高於同業；由於巨額資本開支幾乎與經營現金流相當，自由現金流略為負值且不足以覆蓋股息。
債務主要為長期，大部分於五年後到期，僅少部分於未來十二個月內到期；再融資需求可控但屬經常性，而低流動比率反映公用事業營運資金結構而非近期流動性壓力。

overall_credit_view.text: Eversource呈現受監管電力公用事業信用，具備可靠的經營現金流及改善中的槓桿與覆蓋趨勢，在槓桿及現金流對債務方面略優於行業中位數；指示性的高槓桿狀況反映資本密集而非困境。
我們的判斷是信用質量取決於監管結果及資本計劃的資金安排，因自由現金流為負且分派吸收經營現金流；利息覆蓋率低於同業及已披露的非經常性費用值得監察，距下一槓桿升級門檻的緩衝有限。
